entry.title: TelemetryTV Issue - November 16, 2026, 14:16 PCT
entry.content:
Nov 20, 13:25 MST
Resolved - UBC Digital Signage service has been restored. Users are now able to log in and use the system as normal.

Nov 18, 08:56 MST
Update - UBC IT and TelemetryTV continue to work on validation of remediating steps. TelemetryTV users are advised to refrain from accessing the system or making updates at this time, to allow this validation work to conclude.

Nov 17, 10:47 MST
Identified - TelemetryTV has identified the cause of the issue and is actively remediating. There is currently no time estimate available for full restoration of the service.

Nov 16, 14:17 MST
Investigating - We're aware of an issue affecting access to TelemetryTV. All login methods are currently returning an error, and users are unable to access the platform. TelemetryTV is actively working to restore access.

• All login methods are currently unavailable.
• Users are unable to access their accounts or make changes to the platform.
• Existing content saved on digital signage players should continue playing normally while access is being restored.

We're following up with TelemetryTV for further updates. We don't yet have a confirmed timeline for when platform access will be restored, but we'll share more information in this channel as it becomes available.
